statements.t: We expect this increase in revenue to continue as we bring on more insurance payors, and our scan volumes increase.
We expect salaries and benefits to continue at this higher level in the fourth quarter of 2026.
We expect these expenses to increase in the fourth quarter of 2026 as enrollment is expected to increase in the coming months and years due to the expanded CLARITY enrollment criteria.
We expect research and development expenses to continue to increase as we continue the development of Nociscan 3.0.
We expect revenue to continue to increase as we add insurance payors and our scan volumes increase.
The amount of revenue recognized reflects the consideration the Company expects to receive in exchange for those services.
The Company expects that cash used in operating activities may increase in future periods as it continues to develop its business.

We will remain an emerging growth company until the earliest of (1) the last day of the fiscal year (a) following the fifth anniversary of the completion of our IPO, which is December 31, 2027, (b) in which we have total annual gross revenue of at least $1.235 billion or (c) in which we are deemed to be a large accelerated filer, which means the market value of our common stock that is held by non-affiliates…

estimates.name: Revenue Recognition
estimates.t: The Company derives its revenues from one source, the delivery of Nociscan reports to medical professionals.
